item.title: Why SWE-bench Verified no longer measures frontier coding capabilities
QNX on the Commodore 900 – Raiders of the lost hard drive [video]
item.description:
📝 In 1984 Commodore introduced the C900, a budget Unix workstation with an obscure Zilog Z8000 processor. Without a working power supply, monitor, keyboard and with the hard drive giving a mysterious 0xFF error, I was left puzzling on how to make the machine run. After I figured out how to make the machine run, I have helped two other Commodore 900 owners with the same problems to make their machines fully working.
🔗 Read more: https://archive.fosdem.org/2025/schedule/event/fosdem-2025-5479-raiders-of-the-lost-hard-drive/
